verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale offering a self-hostable control or coordination plane, so the core product can't be shown to be self-hosted. The docs only cover running Tailscale nodes on your own infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes sidecars, subnet routers, exit nodes and tsidp. One community comment says most clients can point at a 'custom control server' (except iOS), but no Tailscale-provided server is evidenced, so that is a client-side hook rather than the capability itself.
